causal_diagnosis.primary_logic_failure: Broad spot/perpetual participation plus one-minute L1 persistence did not distinguish durable price discovery from a short-lived impulse.
causal_diagnosis.liquidity_selection_failure: Anonymous rolling four-hour boundaries were not tied to participant handoff or inventory context.
causal_diagnosis.execution_failure: Several market fills occurred beyond the planned structural stop and were fail-closed; this does not rescue the 1-of-8 economic outcome.
causal_diagnosis.decision: Reject the complete candidate. Preserve the broad-participation state concept, but require participant-linked regional liquidity and same-leg geometry.
